keyPoints.en: The plasma membrane follows the fluid mosaic model: a phospholipid bilayer with proteins floating in it.
keyPoints.bm: Membran plasma mengikut model mozek bendalir: dwilapisan fosfolipid dengan protein yang terapung di dalamnya.

keyPoints.en: Phospholipids have hydrophilic heads (facing water) and hydrophobic tails (facing inwards).
keyPoints.bm: Fosfolipid mempunyai kepala hidrofilik (menghadap air) dan ekor hidrofobik (menghadap ke dalam).

keyPoints.en: Channel proteins and carrier proteins help substances that can't cross the bilayer.
keyPoints.bm: Protein liang dan protein pembawa membantu bahan yang tidak dapat merentasi dwilapisan.

keyPoints.en: Cholesterol keeps the membrane stable; glycoproteins act as markers for cell recognition.
keyPoints.bm: Kolesterol menstabilkan membran; glikoprotein bertindak sebagai penanda untuk pengecaman sel.

keyPoints.en: The membrane is semi-permeable: it controls what enters and leaves the cell.
keyPoints.bm: Membran adalah separa telap: ia mengawal bahan yang masuk dan keluar sel.

question.en: Why can't glucose diffuse straight through the phospholipid bilayer?
question.bm: Mengapa glukosa tidak boleh meresap terus melalui dwilapisan fosfolipid?

answer.en: Glucose is large and water-soluble, so it can't pass the hydrophobic tails; it needs carrier proteins.
answer.bm: Glukosa besar dan larut air, jadi tidak dapat melepasi ekor hidrofobik; ia memerlukan protein pembawa.

tip.en: Practise drawing and labelling the fluid mosaic model — it's a common structured question.
tip.bm: Berlatih melukis dan melabel model mozek bendalir — soalan struktur yang biasa.

keyPoints.en: Passive transport needs no energy and moves substances DOWN a concentration gradient.
keyPoints.bm: Pengangkutan pasif tidak memerlukan tenaga dan menggerakkan bahan MENGIKUT kecerunan kepekatan.

keyPoints.en: Simple diffusion: through the bilayer (O₂, CO₂, fat-soluble vitamins).
keyPoints.bm: Resapan ringkas: melalui dwilapisan (O₂, CO₂, vitamin larut lemak).

keyPoints.en: Facilitated diffusion: through channel or carrier proteins (glucose, amino acids, ions).
keyPoints.bm: Resapan berbantu: melalui protein liang atau pembawa (glukosa, asid amino, ion).

keyPoints.en: Osmosis: water moves across a semi-permeable membrane from dilute to concentrated solution.
keyPoints.bm: Osmosis: air bergerak merentasi membran separa telap dari larutan cair ke pekat.

keyPoints.en: Active transport: AGAINST the gradient using carrier proteins and ATP (e.g. Na⁺/K⁺ pump). Endo/exocytosis move large materials in vesicles.
keyPoints.bm: Pengangkutan aktif: MELAWAN kecerunan menggunakan protein pembawa dan ATP (cth. pam Na⁺/K⁺). Endo/eksositosis menggerakkan bahan besar dalam vesikel.

question.en: If a cell's mitochondria stop working, which transport stops?
question.bm: Jika mitokondria sel berhenti berfungsi, pengangkutan manakah berhenti?

answer.en: Active transport, because it needs ATP from respiration.
answer.bm: Pengangkutan aktif, kerana ia memerlukan ATP daripada respirasi.

tip.en: Key word test: 'against the gradient' or 'energy' → active transport.
tip.bm: Kata kunci: 'melawan kecerunan' atau 'tenaga' → pengangkutan aktif.

keyPoints.en: Examples: gas exchange in alveoli (diffusion), absorption in villi (diffusion + active transport), reabsorption in kidneys, water uptake in root hairs (osmosis).
keyPoints.bm: Contoh: pertukaran gas di alveolus (resapan), penyerapan di vilus (resapan + pengangkutan aktif), penyerapan semula di ginjal, pengambilan air oleh rambut akar (osmosis).

keyPoints.en: Hypotonic solution: water enters cells. Animal cells burst (haemolysis); plant cells become turgid.
keyPoints.bm: Larutan hipotonik: air masuk ke sel. Sel haiwan pecah (hemolisis); sel tumbuhan menjadi segah.

keyPoints.en: Hypertonic solution: water leaves cells. Animal cells shrink (crenation); plant cells plasmolyse.
keyPoints.bm: Larutan hipertonik: air keluar dari sel. Sel haiwan mengecut (krenasi); sel tumbuhan mengalami plasmolisis.

keyPoints.en: Isotonic: no net movement. Plasmolysed cells recover in water (deplasmolysis).
keyPoints.bm: Isotonik: tiada pergerakan bersih. Sel plasmolisis pulih dalam air (deplasmolisis).

keyPoints.en: The cell wall stops plant cells bursting — turgor pressure keeps plants upright.
keyPoints.bm: Dinding sel menghalang sel tumbuhan pecah — tekanan segah memastikan tumbuhan tegak.

question.en: Why don't plant cells burst in distilled water?
question.bm: Mengapa sel tumbuhan tidak pecah dalam air suling?

answer.en: The strong cellulose cell wall resists the swelling, so the cell becomes turgid instead.
answer.bm: Dinding sel selulosa yang kuat menahan pengembangan, jadi sel menjadi segah.

tip.en: 'Hypo' = less solute (more water). 'Hyper' = more solute. Water always moves towards more solute.
tip.bm: 'Hipo' = kurang zat terlarut (lebih air). 'Hiper' = lebih zat terlarut. Air sentiasa bergerak ke arah lebih zat terlarut.

keyPoints.en: Salting fish and making sweet jams/pickles preserve food by drawing water out of microorganisms (hypertonic).
keyPoints.bm: Pengasinan ikan dan pembuatan jem/jeruk mengawet makanan dengan menarik air keluar dari mikroorganisma (hipertonik).

keyPoints.en: Soaking limp vegetables in plain water makes them crisp again (water enters by osmosis).
keyPoints.bm: Merendam sayur layu dalam air biasa menjadikannya segar semula (air masuk secara osmosis).

keyPoints.en: Oral rehydration solution and isotonic drip (saline) replace lost water and ions without damaging cells.
keyPoints.bm: Larutan pemulihan oral dan titisan isotonik (salin) menggantikan air dan ion yang hilang tanpa merosakkan sel.

keyPoints.en: Excess fertiliser makes soil hypertonic, so plants lose water and wilt.
keyPoints.bm: Baja berlebihan menjadikan tanah hipertonik, jadi tumbuhan kehilangan air dan layu.

keyPoints.en: Dialysis machines use a semi-permeable membrane to remove waste from blood.
keyPoints.bm: Mesin dialisis menggunakan membran separa telap untuk menyingkirkan bahan buangan daripada darah.

question.en: Why is the drip given to hospital patients isotonic?
question.bm: Mengapa titisan yang diberi kepada pesakit hospital adalah isotonik?

answer.en: So blood cells neither gain nor lose water — no haemolysis or crenation.
answer.bm: Supaya sel darah tidak menerima atau kehilangan air — tiada hemolisis atau krenasi.

tip.en: In application questions, state the solution type, the direction of water movement, and the effect on cells.
tip.bm: Dalam soalan aplikasi, nyatakan jenis larutan, arah pergerakan air, dan kesan pada sel.
